verificationSummary: PLAN audited Project Control Editor records by checking whether cited Editor commits exist in the canonical flowdoc-vnext-editor repository or only in the old FlowDocEditor repository. The earliest confirmed drift is old FlowDocEditor commit e78ae4160d1ab1759961dbeb3d646beb3490ec46 on 2026-09-03 17:46 +0700 for lane-design-workspace-usability. The next old-only commits are cb3c1ca4e35973c3bd4f89d969826911e109e55c, 65ab5b149c5aad10b36bbaa23650b9fce7070dff, 3ac90724a5dd6ea92f1d7a9cde11dfb19fa0b48c, 78dbae50e234487e64c58eae5480d8a8f1c16f97, 76e32076a6588fb48def07daaf08825c41afa334, and 715dd2e7edf0e7a3592ab7ff7e55cced361c836a. PLAN opened recovery WORK rooms targeting only flowdoc-vnext-editor. The workspace status strip WORK room returned PASS at vNext commit 9e0097d87e91923218825021d4b7f0f9c60b7930; PLAN verified the commit exists in flowdoc-vnext-editor and not old FlowDocEditor, reviewed the diff, ran focused tests, fast-forwarded Editor main, and ran npm run check on main with 110 test files and 398 tests passing plus build. The selected-region command summary WORK room first returned a mistyped full hash, so PLAN sent a Revision Packet back to the same WORK room; the corrected handoff returned PASS at vNext commit 8b966ee30f6a978a3c20d8b2abf640d3d3eac86e. PLAN verified the corrected commit exists in flowdoc-vnext-editor and not old FlowDocEditor, reviewed the diff, ran focused tests, merged it to Editor main as 8bcc17563daa91780dc01fbb8a7bf90eedc0cbea, and ran npm run check on main with 111 test files and 403 tests passing plus build. The Structure Pattern Build/Preview foundation WORK room returned PASS/RISK at vNext commit 7a99bd0f959de8671f5e0fe5bf59fad1e98d4151. PLAN verified that commit exists in flowdoc-vnext-editor and not old FlowDocEditor, reviewed the diff, ran focused Structure Pattern Build/Preview tests, merged it to Editor main as 12d3ebe0a9b69d054d66cf7752c836651c7ec2f2, and reran the focused main verification with 5 test files and 15 tests passing. Full Editor npm run check failed because @flowdoc/text-engine-rust-wasm module paths could not be resolved; PLAN reproduced the same type-check failure on Editor main after aborting the Structure Pattern merge, proving the full-gate blocker is a pre-existing local Core dependency state rather than a Structure Pattern lane regression. The old commits remain historical/suspect records only and must not be used as canonical vNext Editor evidence. Build/Preview usability recovery after the Structure Pattern foundation remains pending for old FlowDocEditor commits 3ac90724a5dd6ea92f1d7a9cde11dfb19fa0b48c, 78dbae50e234487e64c58eae5480d8a8f1c16f97, 76e32076a6588fb48def07daaf08825c41afa334, and 715dd2e7edf0e7a3592ab7ff7e55cced361c836a. This evidence does not promote FlowDoc product truth, map truth, frontend readiness, WYSIWYG readiness, Preview readiness, Backend readiness, Core readiness, runtime submission persistence, generated PDF files, production readiness, or release readiness.
